meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude会引导你完成文档共创的三个阶段：收集背景、逐节迭代优化、用新对话测试可读性，确保文档对读者清晰有效。
howto.when: 当你提到要写文档、提案、技术规范、决策文档等结构化内容时，Claude会主动提供这个协作工作流。

say.text: 我想写一份技术方案，咱们一起讨论吧。
帮我起草一个决策文档。
写完之后帮我测试一下可读性。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a structured co-authoring workflow: gather context, iteratively refine sections, and test readability with a fresh instance to ensure the document works for readers.
howto.when_en: When you mention writing documents, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content, Claude offers this workflow.

say_en.note: Claude starts the Context Gathering stage.

say_en.text: Draft a decision document for me.
say_en.note: Claude follows the Refinement & Structure process.

say_en.text: Test my document's readability after drafting.
say_en.note: Claude runs Reader Testing with a fresh instance.
